note: Spiral-bound conjugation-chart booklet, source line on every chart: 'Intensive Arabic Semester, Givat Haviva (c) arabic2use'. Structure: pp.1-2 (PDF/PNG numbering) are upright overview tables of the awzan (p.1 Fusha, p.2 colloquial, with handwritten English glosses). From p.3 on, every odd page is a printed conjugation chart scanned sideways (rotated 90 degrees), and each chart's verso (the following even page) is either blank or carries the student's handwritten vocabulary list for that verb form. Chart pages carry printed page numbers 1-12 in an oval: printed N = PNG page (2N+1), i.e. p.3=chart 1 ... p.25=chart 12. Blank versos: pp.8, 18, 20, 22, 24; p.16 has only a handwritten header. TEACHING SEQUENCE: Form 1 in four vowel-class charts (سمع i-type, فتح a-type, طبخ u-type, عزم i-imperfect), then Forms 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,10 - one exemplar verb each; Form 9 is omitted (also missing from the overview tables). Each chart has the same fixed layout of boxed paradigms (10 persons: أنا، إنت، إنتِ، هو، هي، إحنا، إنتو/إنتوا، إنتن، هم، هن): Past, Past negative (both 'ما فعل' and 'ما-فعلش' variants), Present (b-imperfect), Present negative (both 'ما بفعل' and 'بفعلش'), Infinitive-or-future, Negative future, plus (where given) Imperative + negative imperative (4 persons), AP and PP or Gerund (4 gender/number forms, each with مش negative). PEDAGOGICALLY NOTABLE: the future auxiliary is deliberately rotated across charts - بدّي+subjunctive (charts 1, 11), لازم+subjunctive (charts 2, 4, 9), رح+subjunctive (charts 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12) - so the learner meets all three; negatives are مش before رح/لازم but ما...(ش) around بدّ-. TRANSCRIPTION NOTE: chart cells are printed with partial vocalization, but scan quality does not allow reading every haraka reliably, so table cells are transcribed without diacritics (letters, hamzas and final kasra of إنتِ forms preserved); diacritics are kept in titles, the p.1-2 overview tables and the special-variant boxes where they are the point and clearly legible. Handwritten marginalia are recorded in notes.

sections.topic: أَلْأَوْزان - أَللُّغَة أَلْفُصْحى (The verb forms - Modern Standard Arabic)
sections.explanation: Full-page reference table of the verb forms in Fusha. Columns (right to left): أَلْوَزْن (form number), أَلْماضي (past), أَلْمُضارِع (present), أَلْأَمْر (imperative), إِسْم الْفاعِل (active participle), إِسْم الْمَفْعُول (passive participle), أَلْمَصْدَر (verbal noun). Rows for forms 1-8 and 10; form 9 is omitted throughout the book.

sections.topic: إِلْأَوْزان - إِللّغَة الْعامِيَّة (The verb forms - colloquial)
sections.explanation: Same table for spoken Palestinian Arabic. Passive-participle cells for forms 5 and 7 are left blank (dash). Handwritten student glosses under the column headers: أَلمَصْدَر = 'verb action', إسم المفعول = 'passive participle', إسم الفاعل = 'active participle', الأمر = 'command', المضارع = 'present/future', الماضي = 'past'.

title.en: Form 1, Perfect Verb - to hear, listen

units.note: Printed chart page 1. Nine boxed paradigms: Past, Past negative, Present, Present negative, Infinitive/future (with بدّي), Negative future (double variant: ما بدّي أسمع / بدّيش أسمع), Imperative + negative imperative, AP, PP. Verso (p.4) carries handwritten Form-1 vocabulary.

sections.note: Handwritten student list of Form 1 (fi3il i-type) past-tense verbs with English glosses, on the verso of the سمع chart.

units.note: Printed chart page 2. Same nine-box layout; the future column here is built with لازم (أنا لازم أفتح) and its negative with مش لازم. AP feminine plural is printed فتحات (not فاتحات). Verso (p.6) carries handwritten vocabulary.

sections.note: Handwritten student list of Form 1 (fatah a-type) past-tense verbs with English glosses.

units.note: Printed chart page 3. Future column uses رح; negative future مش رح. Present-tense vowels are the u-type (بُطبُخ). Imperative uses أُ (أُطبخ!). Verso (p.8) is blank.

sections.topic: Another common conjugation only in 3 pronouns
sections.explanation: Extra box showing a common u-u vowel variant of طبخ for the three suffixed pronouns (present, future and imperative).

units.note: Printed chart page 4. Future column uses لازم; negative future مش لازم. Verso (p.10) carries a short handwritten list.

sections.topic: Another common conjugation only in 3 pronouns
sections.explanation: Extra box, here demonstrated with the verb عرف (to know): vowel-elided variant for the three suffixed pronouns, with present, future and imperative.

sections.note: Handwritten; headed 'Building 1 - …'. A second small group (عرف، نزل) is written lower on the page.

units.note: Printed chart page 5. First Form 2 chart; a Gerund box appears instead of a passive participle. Future with رح / مش رح. Verso (p.12) carries handwritten Form-2 vocabulary.

sections.note: Gerund box (replaces the passive-participle box on this chart).
Handwritten; headed 'Building 2 verbs' (fa33al pattern), with English glosses.

title.en: Form 3, Perfect Verb - to travel, go by vehicle

units.note: Printed chart page 6. Future with رح / مش رح. Verso (p.14) carries handwritten Form-3 vocabulary.

sections.note: Gerund box; the chart marks سفر as irregular and adds two more Form-3 gerunds. Handwritten gloss next to 'Gerund': 'name of the action'. Handwritten 'Command' written above the imperative box.

units.note: Printed chart page 7. The initial أ of the past drops in the present (بكرم). Future with رح / مش رح. Verso (p.16) has only the handwritten header 'Form 4 Verbs = xxx أ' with no entries.

Printed chart page 8. Future with رح / مش رح. No gerund or passive-participle box. Handwritten note above the title (unclear, appears to read 'Dars is alone/above'). Handwritten margin note: 'Second form becomes reflective in the fifth building.' Verso (p.18) is blank.

title.en: Form 6, Perfect Verb - to be helped by

units.note: Printed chart page 9. Future with لازم / مش لازم. The AP box is filled with a different Form-6 verb, متعاطف (from تعاطف), not تساعد. Handwritten margin notes: 'meaning -' and 'Third building words can fit in the 6th building.' Verso (p.20) is blank.

title.en: Form 7, Perfect Verb - to be forced

units.note: Printed chart page 10. Only the six tense paradigms are given - no imperative, participle or gerund boxes. Future with رح / مش رح. Handwritten margin note: 'The first building becomes reflective in the 7th form.' Verso (p.22) is blank.

Printed chart page 11. Future with بدّي (أنا بدي أشتغل) and negative ما بدي أشتغل (single variant printed). Both participle boxes are filled with a different Form-8 verb, اشترك: AP مشترك (kasra) and PP مُشتَرَك (fatha). Verso (p.24) is blank.

Printed chart page 12 (last form; Form 9 is skipped in this book). Future with رح / مش رح. The AP box is filled with a different Form-10 verb, مستعجل (from استعجل 'to hurry'); the PP box uses مستعمل. Handwritten notes: 'Building 10: "Thought something to be" / "Ask for something" / Bastafham = "I don't understand, explain it"' and, at the bottom of the chart, 'أنا عم بستعمل - using am I' (student note on عم + present = progressive). The sheet's verso is p.26, outside this fragment - by the book's pattern it may carry handwritten Form-10 vocabulary, so this unit is marked continues:true.
